proposal.summary: Authenticated command injection in Comtrend VR-3033 ping and traceroute diagnostic pages allows an authenticated user to execute shell commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the pingIpAddress parameter, resulting in command execution on the device.
proposal.cwe_quote: on the text input, type 'google.fr;ls - l'

PR.quote: To reproduce the vulnerability attacker has to access the interface at least with minimum privilege.

C.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

I.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

A.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the injection in a test environment, capture the exact vulnerable backend command invocation, and apply input sanitization or use safe APIs; produce a patch that rejects shell metacharacters and/or runs diagnostics without invoking a shell.
